message: hi youuu <3 ☘︎☀︎                 i never really know how to start these things without feeling a little silly, but i wanted to write you another letter because i love writing them and sometimes i think it’s nice to put things into words because i never know how to say them out loud. i hope you always know how much i enjoy being around you. you always give me so many little reasons to smile, and i think that’s a pretty lovely thing. i like that we’re still in that stage where there’s so much left to learn about each other. there are still so many stories i haven’t heard, so many random things i don’t know about you yet, and so many little moments we haven’t gotten to have. like i just got to see a million pictures of the cutest puppy everrr!!  i don’t need to know everything about the future to enjoy what’s happening right now, and right now, i’m really glad i get to spend so much of my time with you. i know life can get busy and overwhelming sometimes, and you might not always give yourself enough credit for the things you do, when youre genuienly the most all around amazing person i know. basically i dont want you to feel like you have to impress me every second. i just love getting to know the real you :] and for the record, you really are so so so cute. unfortunately for you, i will always continue to think so, and there’s not much you can do to get me to stop saying it. 𖹭 i’m not going to pretend i know exactly what everything will look like down the road. i just want you to know that i really appreciate you, i love spending time with you, and i’m happy we found our way into each other’s lives. i think getting to know you is one of my favorite things, and i’m looking forward to all the memories we still get to make !! so if you ever need a reminder that someone is rooting for you, that someone thinks you’re pretty great, or that someone is genuinely happy to hear from you, you can come back to this letter. because i am, and i hope you never ever have to wonder about that. <3 happy one month max ⋆｡‧˚ʚ🍓ɞ˚‧｡⋆ p.s. i hope this made you smile, because that was kind of the whole point. mwhehe ♡ p.p.s. i can update this remotely whenever, so expect more notes sporatically :]
